findings: The full acquisition policy retrieved fewer near-stable historical labels than quality ranking in all five frozen splits.
Symmetry-conditioned control samples had higher primary exact-cell yield, with one relaxed energy pair per composition.
None of the 48 new-formula transformer draws passed the frozen exact-cell gate.
All four prototype baselines converged under CHGNet; convergence does not establish stability.
The generated MgO DFT result recovers a known rock-salt reference; the perturbation and full competitor inventory remain incomplete.
hypothesis: Explicit predictive uncertainty during symmetry-constrained generation may improve stable, novel crystal discovery in underrepresented chemical spaces.
scientificLimits: Five splits reuse one overlapping WBM population; mean and sample SD are descriptive, with no independent-seed significance claim.
Prediction intervals are empirically scaled using chemical-system calibration groups. Group shift and repeated adaptive reuse prevent an arbitrary-OOD coverage guarantee.
The fixed full policy lost to quality on all five near-stable-hit endpoints; coefficients, models and calibration remain unchanged after this result.
Historical signed hull-distance hits are retrieval from existing DFT labels, not newly calculated, novel or DFT-confirmed stable material discoveries.
Calibration and evaluation groups are disjoint within a seed; pretrained generator or CHGNet training-set contamination is outside this supervised replay audit.
Uncertainty-error association and selective risk diagnostics do not establish calibrated uncertainty for fresh generated crystals or QM energy predictions.
Within-architecture sampling contrast only; one energy pair per composition
MgO topup results supplementary; primary first-eight denominators unchanged
New-to-reference composition means absent only from two pinned historical catalogs
P1 geometry unmatched to pinned same-composition subset does not prove global novelty
Prototype CHGNet convergence and absolute raw energies are not formation energies or hull stability
No fresh candidate CaMg2O3 QE result; 159 primary and 56 fallback reference entries uncomputed
Known MgO recovery is not discovery; perturbation incomplete; no phonon local-minimum proof
